sens_en: to catch, to capture, to arrest
origine_fr: Une main 扌 et 甫, qui donnait le son ; il se lit fǔ et ne garde que la finale de bǔ. 捕 veut dire « prendre ». Le sens a peu changé : attraper, capturer, arrêter.
origine_en: A hand 扌 and 甫, which gave the sound; it is read fǔ and keeps only the final of bǔ. 捕 means “to seize”. The meaning has barely changed: to catch, to capture, to arrest.

phrase.zh: 他们每天早上出海捕鱼。
phrase.fr: Chaque matin, ils partent en mer pêcher.
phrase.en: Every morning they head out to sea to fish.
